In heavy transport sectors like gravel and asphalt hauling, profit margins often come down to a single critical metric: cost-per-load. Moving heavy aggregates requires massive power, which historically meant consuming high volumes of fuel. Balancing required torque with fuel economy is one of the most effective ways to support data-driven ROI for vocational fleets.

The International® S13 Integrated Powertrain is engineered to help fleet managers balance this equation. By combining the engine, transmission, and aftertreatment system into a single synchronized unit, this powertrain promotes substantial fuel efficiency gains without sacrificing performance. At Rechtien International Trucks, we offer the region’s commercial fleets access to this advanced technology alongside dedicated local service and support.

S13 Powertrain Engineering: Driving Fuel Gains for South Florida Fleets

The S13 Integrated Powertrain shifts away from traditional heavy-duty engine architecture. Older engines frequently rely on complex Exhaust Gas Recirculation (EGR) coolers that create backpressure and reduce efficiency. The S13 utilizes a clean-sheet design featuring a dual-stage aftertreatment system, allowing the engine to breathe freely and achieve cleaner, more complete fuel combustion.

Key engineering features designed to promote efficiency include:

items.label: Low-RPM Torque Generation:
items.desc: Operates efficiently at lower engine speeds while maintaining the pulling power needed for heavy gravel trailers.

items.label: T14 Automated Manual Transmission:
items.desc: A 14-speed AMT designed to keep the engine in its sweet spot during steep climbs and city traffic.

items.label: Predictive Cruise Control:
items.desc: Adjusts shifting strategies based on terrain to help avoid unnecessary fuel burn.

props.text: Maximizing Payload for Gravel & Asphalt Haulers in Riviera Beach, Ft. Pierce, & Ft. Myers

Improving fuel efficiency addresses one side of the ROI equation; increasing payload capacity addresses the other. For fleet managers running routes through Riviera Beach, Ft. Pierce, and Ft. Myers, payload weight directly impacts daily revenue.

The S13 Integrated Powertrain stands as one of the lighter powertrains in its class. By removing unnecessary engine components and utilizing advanced composite materials, the powertrain offers significant weight savings over legacy systems.

items.label: More Billable Tonnage:
items.desc: Every pound saved on engine weight allows for an extra pound of gravel or asphalt per haul.

items.label: Fewer Required Trips:
items.desc: Higher payload capacity per run can lower the total number of trips required to complete a job, reducing overall wear and tear.
